Take a Quick SMS-Magic Trial!

**Welcome to SMS Magic!**

SMS Magic offers a complete suite that works with your choice of CRMs and marketing automation applications. We have been the preferred solution for Salesforce & Zoho customers. SMS-Magic works with CRM and all other apps, such as marketing and service apps from the CRM family. We have partnered with Vertical Solutions built on [Force.com](http://force.com/) and Zoho Platform or built from scratch to enable them to a full suite of messaging experiences rather than just an SMS API endpoint.

![](https://media.trainn.co/beconversive/article_images/h2FJ0W5PU6vtQemYGllZaQ.png?Expires=1794378535&Signature=nvGgOMR9e2LfM1kSFm0rjcdL-MqCiVJWtMZJMErUMpqZiKw15hFPZX5UzUsNFCn-clwv5fWxzFeBLHyzt8kG0S7u4t5qfas78V57wRopHASoovv0X5PkMr1Nh-WKTcOvjmoWINAnkjkrhk-zCffFd8-vO6imhW2qc7-1I26wjiUbKiNEhKMmB6VxrPqiQcvGOpOoNd~M-KmBVnpr3brlO9XtMxg2PJHnBNpRSGLbHoXW6RQ5SBkd8vYfC1ZCiy2M2-EgzLOYzr1oCh6pMeGQdm7EQixc1KeYlNUHzEvwkiwLgd-otCX-qq2Gufmb9jr87Zt4ocnNi06KAhCo41rNyQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K1HNJ3N9MZY0EV)

**We have provided different ways for you to explore SMS Magic.**

**Once you submit your interest with SMS Magic, you have the following options:-**

**1) You can work with our Solutions Experts to get onboarded.**

**2) You can take a quick product overview using video guides.**

**3) You can directly jump in to take a hands-on trial of the product suite with a few trial credits & numbers.**

> SMS Magic offers 15 days of free trial and offers you free credits to test messaging.

**Before you start, let's look at must-have apps of SMS Magic**

SMS Magic has multiple product/application offerings and different entry points to begin using SMS Magic apps.

![](https://media.trainn.co/beconversive/article_images/MuCtHQXBKaFr7G5ZjyKxgw.png?Expires=1794378535&Signature=eAFyceu8yP6vFBAvCunebVI4OyR6xO2KguVlgUL8Vk~6Q7BiMWrTI85tagLXd2qc5sf8mgB0QTOFYBm2QiaI0qRFM-LDI1C~Su5TTermNII-pv-a8qYGpeR-zUD~jwuCqWh2Ae18Jv32cOBHb4lee7gNYKleSzcPwcj3Q3QDCbd9xmpTCMjZzTr1Al1tMReiMxERPvzsCgyXJ~7vZQ50BGTANpto-5rRSHPmFLrat-jlJBmGuI7cmQb5n3zCEmAgF2YCfD-5S~8S8nNAORtK34cg3Wj5IZ2MTxftRb-A3YX216REXhQqYic0rPSyKxZuzTXBxbi5TqOIXFsFpstPGA__&Key-Pair-Id=K1HNJ3N9MZY0EV)

You will have to use the following apps.

**1) ) SMS Magic Web App** \- You will need to sign up for SMS Magic account first. For Non-CRM users, the web app has all features available in the native version of the app.

**2) Native CRM apps for Salesforce & Zoho**\- After signup, you will be prompted to get a Native CRM app if you are looking to get your CRM apps.

**3) SMS Magic Mobile app**\- If you have heavy conversation usage, you can download & start using the SMS-Magic mobile app.

> Keep in mind, Messaging is an highly regulated industry, you will need to under go a compliance registration process according to the country of operations. SMS Magic provides managed services to help you complete all compliance related tasks.
>
> US Customers need to undergo mandatory 10DLC Compliance. [Know more](https://docs.sms-magic.com/articles/tq130UETubs-10dlc-us-a2p)
>
> Indian Customers need to undergo mandatory DLT compliance. [Know more](https://docs.sms-magic.com/articles/XDPxYgcIMnk-dlt)
